transcript: If you leave shit till the last minute, you might want to stay for a sec. But the fact that you're putting something off is a growing guilt and stress, so you feel a bit sick in your and as the deadline gets closer the stress and guilt grows and the sickie grows until the sickie is so bad you'd prefer to deal with a broken bone than another moment of nausea you always do the less painful thing at first it's the task so you procrastinate then it's the consequences of not doing the task so you do the task very stressfully the night before if If you wanna change this loop, I have good news.
